messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

tionId":"prototype-turn:f8dba547-bd90-4ca7-b02f-c26794d59591:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player","character:companion"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨看着日记从玩家手里转到陆舟手上，抱在胸前的手臂松了一点，视线在两人之间来回一趟，没急着开口。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"行，那现在这本日记在陆舟那儿了。你们俩谁先说，这到底是怎么回事？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":99},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:8920b64f-fa5f-4411-898d-9870c239b4a6:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:8920b64f-fa5f-4411-898d-9870c239b4a6:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:friend"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟把日记在手里掂了一下，没翻开，抬眼看向程雨。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"我也刚拿到。他翻了两页就塞给我了。你要问，得问他。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":105},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:816965ff-3031-4ff5-b0e4-3322bdec5610:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:816965ff-3031-4ff5-b0e4-3322bdec5610:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:companion","character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨把抱在胸前的手放下来，撑在台面边缘，视线在陆舟和玩家之间停住。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"行，那就问他。我等着听。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":110},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:a8e8ff66b8aaaafed02ebf13","value":{"actionId":"action:d46b46287862a587dfa3a6d0","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"陆舟、程雨，雨听起来小一些了吗？说说你们现在的心情。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":116},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:0021dfd4-e9d6-4c52-8da2-856ab80b6877:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:0021dfd4-e9d6-4c52-8da2-856ab80b6877:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player","character:friend"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟侧头听了听窗外的雨，又低头看了眼手里的日记，没翻开。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨是小了点。心情？说不上。手里多了本别人的日记，桌上还有块表，谁的心情能简单。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":122},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:5ea50a21-baa8-4d12-82b8-00fc04501a92:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:5ea50a21-baa8-4d12-82b8-00fc04501a92:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨听陆舟说完，视线在桌上的怀表上停了一下，又转回玩家脸上。她没有去碰表，只是把撑在台面的手指轻轻敲了一下。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨是小了点。心情嘛——我这儿还搁着一块没人认的表，一本刚转手的日记，你又突然问起心情。你先说你的，我再决定要不要跟着说。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":127},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:7d12ba12-7e4f-4b60-ab59-54298eb881dd:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:7d12ba12-7e4f-4b60-ab59-54298eb881dd:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨的手指在台面上又敲了一下，这次停住了。她看了看玩家，又看了看桌上那块没人认领的怀表，没有伸手。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"行，我先说。我在这儿看台子，最怕的不是东西丢，是东西没人来认。这块表搁了一下午，日记又转了两手——我心情就是有点悬着，说不上好，也说不上坏。你呢？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":132},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:2b16c3a9a1a58d2975bc9046","value":{"actionId":"action:2f138da8e44cc6b4e46d7b78","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"聊个别的话题吧，你们喜欢雨天还是晴天？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":138},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:9faa3d52-c66b-40ed-8ac7-653775ca46fe:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:9faa3d52-c66b-40ed-8ac7-653775ca46fe:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟把日记换到左手，右手空出来，像是随口答的。","replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"晴天。路好走。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":144}],"selfObservations":[{"observationId":"self:31","sourceSeq":31,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"","narration":"程雨没有立刻出声，只是把视线从日记移到玩家翻页的手上，停了一瞬。"}},{"observationId":"self:48","sourceSeq":48,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"你翻得挺仔细。看出什么了吗？","narration":"程雨看着玩家把日记放回原处，没有伸手去碰，只把目光在封底停留了一下。"}},{"observationId":"self:64","sourceSeq":64,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"这本日记，你是打算带走？","narration":"程雨看着玩家把日记收进手里，眉头轻轻动了一下，没有立刻阻止，只是把手从台面上收回来，抱在胸前。"}},{"observationId":"self:80","sourceSeq":80,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"放回来，是改主意了，还是只是先搁一下？","narration":"程雨的目光跟着日记落到桌面上，又抬回玩家脸上。她没去碰那本日记，抱在胸前的手也没松开。"}},{"observationId":"self:96","sourceSeq":96,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"行，那现在这本日记在陆舟那儿了。你们俩谁先说，这到底是怎么回事？","narration":"程雨看着日记从玩家手里转到陆舟手上，抱在胸前的手臂松了一点，视线在两人之间来回一趟，没急着开口。"}},{"observationId":"self:107","sourceSeq":107,"content":{"actionType":"speak","te vation:scene-result:511cfe9b8795a8ac5ba961ab","value":{"actionId":"action:becc46628c9d1abe4a80b7bd","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"我把自己保管的布面日记暂放桌上，仍由我保管。","replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":""},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":72},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:97a83b1c-8660-4603-b50a-10e08ecb1f56:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:97a83b1c-8660-4603-b50a-10e08ecb1f56:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨的目光跟着日记落到桌面上，又抬回玩家脸上。她没去碰那本日记，抱在胸前的手也没松开。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"放回来，是改主意了，还是只是先搁一下？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":82},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:f31fdf94df5ff42fc3e16787","value":{"actionId":"action:cc1b2784e3290949a68a62e6","content":{"actionType":"interact","actorId":"character:player","interaction":{"characterId":"character:player","entityId":"entity:diary","fromHolderId":"character:player","fromLocationId":null,"interactionId":"base:give","toHolderId":"character:companion","toLocationId":null},"reason":null,"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":88},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:f8dba547-bd90-4ca7-b02f-c26794d59591:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:f8dba547-bd90-4ca7-b02f-c26794d59591:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player","character:companion"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨看着日记从玩家手里转到陆舟手上，抱在胸前的手臂松了一点，视线在两人之间 messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

urn:8920b64f-fa5f-4411-898d-9870c239b4a6:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:8920b64f-fa5f-4411-898d-9870c239b4a6:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:friend"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟把日记在手里掂了一下，没翻开，抬眼看向程雨。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"我也刚拿到。他翻了两页就塞给我了。你要问，得问他。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":105},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:816965ff-3031-4ff5-b0e4-3322bdec5610:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:816965ff-3031-4ff5-b0e4-3322bdec5610:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:companion","character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨把抱在胸前的手放下来，撑在台面边缘，视线在陆舟和玩家之间停住。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"行，那就问他。我等着听。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":110},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:a8e8ff66b8aaaafed02ebf13","value":{"actionId":"action:d46b46287862a587dfa3a6d0","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"陆舟、程雨，雨听起来小一些了吗？说说你们现在的心情。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":116},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:0021dfd4-e9d6-4c52-8da2-856ab80b6877:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:0021dfd4-e9d6-4c52-8da2-856ab80b6877:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player","character:friend"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟侧头听了听窗外的雨，又低头看了眼手里的日记，没翻开。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨是小了点。心情？说不上。手里多了本别人的日记，桌上还有块表，谁的心情能简单。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":122},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:5ea50a21-baa8-4d12-82b8-00fc04501a92:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:5ea50a21-baa8-4d12-82b8-00fc04501a92:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨听陆舟说完，视线在桌上的怀表上停了一下，又转回玩家脸上。她没有去碰表，只是把撑在台面的手指轻轻敲了一下。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨是小了点。心情嘛——我这儿还搁着一块没人认的表，一本刚转手的日记，你又突然问起心情。你先说你的，我再决定要不要跟着说。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":127},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:7d12ba12-7e4f-4b60-ab59-54298eb881dd:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:7d12ba12-7e4f-4b60-ab59-54298eb881dd:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨的手指在台面上又敲了一下，这次停住了。她看了看玩家，又看了看桌上那块没人认领的怀表，没有伸手。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"行，我先说。我在这儿看台子，最怕的不是东西丢，是东西没人来认。这块表搁了一下午，日记又转了两手——我心情就是有点悬着，说不上好，也说不上坏。你呢？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":132},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:2b16c3a9a1a58d2975bc9046","value":{"actionId":"action:2f138da8e44cc6b4e46d7b78","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"聊个别的话题吧，你们喜欢雨天还是晴天？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":138},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:9faa3d52-c66b-40ed-8ac7-653775ca46fe:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:9faa3d52-c66b-40ed-8ac7-653775ca46fe:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟把日记换到左手，右手空出来，像是随口答的。","replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"晴天。路好走。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":144},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:4021b6da-1c9e-4e04-8c79-d24b29cd2ac4:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:4021b6da-1c9e-4e04-8c79-d24b29cd2ac4:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨答得干脆，视线从窗外收回来，落在台面上那块怀表上，又抬起来看玩家。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"晴天吧。路好走，东西也好清点。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":149},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:f10396e1-53fc-4aa4-a79d-e389b5c04f57:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:f10396e1-53fc-4aa4-a79d-e389b5c04f57:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨把撑在台面的手收回来，重新抱在胸前，视线在陆舟和玩家之间扫了一圈，没接话，只是轻轻点了下头，像是把刚才那句晴天记下了。","replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":""},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":155},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:119ae3036950cc0e21432e6c","value":{"actionId":"action:dabd6cdea2f5708d71a866c6","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"平时等车的时候你们会做些什么？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":161},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:d9a3c04b-0b2d-485c-8be1-1066f9ae2e73:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:d9a3c04b-0b2d-485c-8be1-1066f9ae2e73:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟把日记换回右手，靠着台面边缘，像是想起什么。","replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"等车就站着。看路，看人。没什么可做的。你呢？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":167},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:bcbc05dd-fdf4-4973-908c-9c54f8ad3a0b:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:bcbc05dd-fdf4-4973-908c-9c54f8ad3a0b:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨把抱在胸前的手松开一只，指尖在台面上那块怀表旁边点了点，没碰它。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"等车啊……我一般就盯着站牌看，数还有几站。有时候也看人，看谁着急、谁不着急。你呢，问这个是想聊点别的，还是想套我们的话？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":172},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:0e859e6a-22a8-4f7c-bb02-4d797875c9f7:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:0e859e6a-22a8-4f7c-bb02-4d797875c9f7:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨把抱在胸前的手松开一只，指尖在台面上那块怀表旁边点了点，没碰它。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"等车啊……我一般就盯着站牌看，数还有几站。有时候也看人，看谁着急、谁不着急。你呢，问这个是想聊点别的，还是想套我们的话？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":177},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:6c2a58435aa68fce1ab18c5d","value":{"actionId":"action:5d5dcaeadc4563f0941d001d","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"听一会儿雨声吧，我想歇口气。","replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":""},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":183},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:3378a1b5-ce2c-40c6-b6a2-775cc872df6c:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:3378a1b5-ce2c-40c6-b6a2-775cc872df6c:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟没再说话，把日记往台面上一搁，手还搭在上面，侧头听雨。","replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":""},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":189}],"selfObservations":[{"observationId":"self:96","sourceSeq":96,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"行，那现在这本日记在陆舟那儿了。你们俩谁先说，这到底是怎么回事？","narration":"程雨看着日记从玩家手里转到陆舟手上，抱在胸前的手臂松了一点，视线在两人之间来回一趟，没急着开口。"}},{"observationId":"self:107","sourceSeq":107,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"行，那就问他。我等着听。","narration":"程雨把抱在胸前的手放下来，撑在台面边缘，视线在陆舟和玩家之间停住。"}},{"observationId":"self:125","sourceSeq":125,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"雨是小了点。心情嘛——我这儿还搁着一块没人认的表，一本刚转手的日记，你又突然问起心情。你先说你的，我再决定要不要跟着说。","narration":"程雨听陆舟说完，视线在桌上的怀表上停了一下，又转回玩家脸上。她没有去碰表，只是把撑在台面的手指轻轻敲了一下。"}},{"observationId":"self:130","sourceSeq":130,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"行，我先说。我在这儿看台子，最怕的不是东西丢，是东西没人来认。这块表搁了一下午，日记又转了两手——我心情就是有点悬着，说不上好，也说不上坏。你呢？","narration":"程雨的手指在台面上又敲了一下，这次停住了。她看了看玩家，又看了看桌上那块没人认领的怀表，没有伸手。"}},{"observationId":"self:147","sourceSeq":147,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"晴天吧。路好走，东西也好清点。","narration":"程雨答得干脆，视线从窗外收回来，落在台面上那块怀表上，又抬起来看玩家。"}},{"observationId":"self:152","sourceSeq":152,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"","narration":"程雨把撑在台面的手收回来，重新抱在胸前，视线在陆舟和玩家之间扫了一圈，没接话，只是轻轻点了下头，像是把刚才那句晴天记下了。"}},{"observationId":"self:170","sourceSeq":170,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"等车啊……我一般就盯着站牌看，数还有几站。有时候也看人，看谁着急、谁不着急。你呢，问这个是想聊点别的，还是想套我们的话？","narration":"程雨把抱在胸前的手松开一只，指尖在台面上那块怀表旁边点了点，没碰它。"}},{"observationId":"self:175","sourceSeq":175,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"等车啊……我一般就盯着站牌看，数还有几站。有时候也看人，看谁着急、谁不着急。你呢，问这个是想聊点别的，还是想套我们的话？","narration":"程雨把抱在胸前的手松开一只，指尖在台面上那块怀表旁边点了点，没碰它。"}}],"claims":[],"goals":[],"items":{"current":[{"entityId":"entity:diary","holderId":"character:companion","locationId":null},{"entityId":"entity:pocket-watch","holderId":null,"locationId":"location:front-room"}],"lastObserved":[]},"affordances":[{"actionType":"speak"},{"actionType":"move","destinations":[{"locationId":"location:back-room","name":"储藏间"}]},{"actionType":"interact","interactions":[{"arguments":{},"bindingId":"binding:key-take","definitionRef":{"id":"base:take","version":1},"targetRef":{"id":"entity:pocket-watch","kind":"entity"}}]}]},"continuation":false,"canPerform":true}

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

"observations":[{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:a8e8ff66b8aaaafed02ebf13","value":{"actionId":"action:d46b46287862a587dfa3a6d0","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"陆舟、程雨，雨听起来小一些了吗？说说你们现在的心情。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":116},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:0021dfd4-e9d6-4c52-8da2-856ab80b6877:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:0021dfd4-e9d6-4c52-8da2-856ab80b6877:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player","character:friend"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟侧头听了听窗外的雨，又低头看了眼手里的日记，没翻开。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨是小了点。心情？说不上。手里多了本别人的日记，桌上还有块表，谁的心情能简单。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":122},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:5ea50a21-baa8-4d12-82b8-00fc04501a92:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:5ea50a21-baa8-4d12-82b8-00fc04501a92:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨听陆舟说完，视线在桌上的怀表上停了一下，又转回玩家脸上。她没有去碰表，只是把撑在台面的手指轻轻敲了一下。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨是小了点。心情嘛——我这儿还搁着一块没人认的表，一本刚转手的日记，你又突然问起心情。你先说你的，我再决定要不要跟着说。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":127},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:7d12ba12-7e4f-4b60-ab59-54298eb881dd:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:7d12ba12-7e4f-4b60-ab59-54298eb881dd:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:fr messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。
